playstyle.identity: Renekton is a lane-dominant early-game bruiser who generates fury for empowered abilities. He excels at snowballing lanes and diving with his ultimate.
playstyle.howToPlay: Fury enhances abilities at 50+. Q heals and damages (more healing empowered). W stuns (empowered breaks shields and stuns longer). E dashes twice if you hit an enemy. R gives health, fury generation, and damages around you.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Renekton spikes at levels 3-6 and with first item. Eclipse or Goredrinker work. He's dominant early but falls off hard late.

passive.name: Reign of Anger
passive.summary: Generate fury from attacks; at 50+ fury, abilities are empowered.
passive.details: Renekton generates fury by attacking and taking damage. At 50+ fury, his next ability is empowered.

abilities.name: Cull the Meek
abilities.summary: Spin and deal damage; heal based on enemies hit. Empowered: more healing.
abilities.details: Renekton swings his blade, dealing damage and healing for each enemy hit. Empowered: Deals more damage and heals significantly more.

abilities.name: Ruthless Predator
abilities.summary: Stun an enemy with your next attack. Empowered: longer stun and breaks shields.
abilities.details: Renekton's next attack stuns the target and hits multiple times. Empowered: Hits more times, stuns longer, and destroys shields.

abilities.name: Slice and Dice
abilities.summary: Dash through enemies; if you hit, can dash again.
abilities.details: Renekton dashes in a direction. If he hits an enemy, he can dash again within a few seconds.

abilities.name: Dominus
abilities.summary: Gain health, size, and fury; deal damage around you over time.
abilities.details: Renekton transforms, gaining bonus health, increasing in size, and dealing damage around him. He also generates fury over time.
